home.heroSubtitle: Cards hold sparks, boxes hold relationships, and the community does one simple thing: give creation a calm, beautiful doorway.
home.belief: We believe tools should feel gentle, modules should stay free, and content should be seen with care.
home.ideaSlowBody: No feed race, just room for work to breathe.
home.ideaModularBody: Cards, boxes, and plugins stay independent while composing naturally.
home.ideaCreatorBody: Sharing is not a noisy square. It is a polished doorway.

about.title: Community intro
about.subtitle: The welcome page explains the community, profile pages hold creation, and the admin console governs the platform.
about.sectionProductBody: Chips Community is not a traditional feed. It is a network of personal showcase pages. Every user gets a clear front door where cards and boxes live together in a refined, restrained, tactile space.
about.sectionArchitectureBody: The server and Host are same-origin in philosophy but fully independent at runtime. The server owns its own Web-specific theme, icon, and i18n systems for browser performance and service delivery.
about.sectionWorkflowBody: Visitors start on the welcome page, learn what the community is, then step into personal pages to browse work. Authors log in and jump into the workspace. Administrators use a separate console for governance.
about.sectionPluginsBody: Plugin capabilities stay aligned with the wider ecosystem, but ordinary web visitors never need to install Host. Shared ideas are copied into the server architecture and then adapted for the Web.

admin.redirectBody: The administrator console is a separate web entry. The client does not embed admin pages. Use the button below to open it in the system browser.

workspace.title: Client publishing
workspace.subtitle: Card upload, full-card download, and local viewing are all handled by the unified card transfer module inside the chips client.
workspace.clientOnlyTitle: Publish cards and boxes from the chips client
workspace.clientOnlyBody: The client transfer module owns resource upload, network-resource card generation, box loose-card upload, web view cache preparation, and full-card download restoration.
workspace.clientOnlyStepCreateBody: Edit and save the complete .card in the desktop or mobile client.
workspace.clientOnlyStepPublishBody: The client uploads resources to object storage, generates a network-resource card, and uploads boxes with their loose cards.
workspace.clientOnlyStepViewBody: After publishing, the browser opens only the community page and view cache.
